title: Google Fonts and Kenney fonts for captions and titles (OFL, Apache, CC0)
summary: Choose OFL/Apache/CC0 caption and title fonts, verify each family's licence folder, and load them in Godot 4, Blender and FFmpeg.
description: Use when picking caption, hook-title or pixel fonts for shorts and Godot UI. Most Google Fonts are SIL OFL 1.1 (a few Apache-2.0), Kenney Fonts are CC0. Covers verifying a family's licence in the google/fonts repo, what OFL allows in videos, and Godot/Blender font import.

source.notes: Describes https://github.com/google/fonts (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
